scope: Eight fresh documents + one Review/Revision; no extra repair/model turns

calculationCalls.command: for f in "ui-hud-desktop.json 1280 64" "ui-hud-portrait.json 390 60"; do set -- $f; echo "=== $1 ($2x$3) ==="; bun .beegame/delivery/check-content.mjs --layout-draft .beegame/tmp/$1 $2 $3 | bun -e 'const j=await Bun.stdin.json(); console.log(JSON.stringify({ok:j.ok,warnings:j.warnings,rects:j.nodes?.map(n=>[n.id,n.rect])},null,0))'; done

echo "-- start 390x844 --"; bun .beegame/delivery/check-content.mjs --layout-draft .beegame/tmp/ui-start.json 390 844 | bun .beegame/tmp/summarize.mjs; echo "-- pause 1280x720 --"; bun .beegame/delivery/check-content.mjs --layout-draft .beegame/tmp/ui-pause.json 1280 720 | bun .beegame/tmp/summarize.mjs; echo "-- pause 390x844 --"; bun .beegame/delivery/chec

echo "-- start 390x844 recheck --"; bun .beegame/delivery/check-content.mjs --layout-draft .beegame/tmp/ui-start.json 390 844 | bun .beegame/tmp/summarize.mjs; echo "-- gameover 1280x720 --"; bun .beegame/delivery/check-content.mjs --layout-draft .beegame/tmp/ui-gameover.json 1280 720 | bun .beegame/tmp/summarize.mjs; echo "-- gameover 390x844 --"; bun .beeg

for f in ui-start-portrait.json:390:844 ui-gameover-portrait.json:390:844; do IFS=: read file w h <<< "$f"; echo "-- $file --"; bun .beegame/delivery/check-content.mjs --layout-draft .beegame/tmp/$file $w $h | bun .beegame/tmp/summarize.mjs; done

echo "-- desktop HUD w/ mute --"; bun .beegame/delivery/check-content.mjs --layout-draft .beegame/tmp/ui-hud-desktop.json 1280 64 | bun .beegame/tmp/summarize.mjs; echo "-- portrait camera input 390x390 (HUD60..450) --"; bun .beegame/delivery/check-content.mjs --camera-draft .beegame/tmp/camera-draft.json 390 390
